settings.heading: What every pair promises.
settings.subheading: If we break any line on this page, message us. We make it right.

settings.title: Dispatch
settings.body: Every order is confirmed by phone call or WhatsApp before it ships. Once confirmed and your Care deposit has reached us, the pair is inspected, relaced, sealed and handed to the courier within 24 hours. Orders confirmed on Sunday or a public holiday dispatch the next working day.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.kicker: Every city in Pakistan. Free delivery.
settings.body:
• Where: every city and town our courier reaches.
  • How long: 2 to 5 days after dispatch in most cities.
  • Fee: free on every order.

Your courier name, tracking number and tracking link arrive on WhatsApp at dispatch, and show on the Track Order page.

settings.title: Payment
settings.kicker: Reserve it small. The rest at your door.
settings.body:
• Your pair is reserved with a small Care deposit by bank transfer: Rs. 500 on orders up to Rs. 3,000, Rs. 1,000 up to Rs. 8,000, Rs. 1,500 up to Rs. 15,000, and the full amount above Rs. 15,000.
  • The rest is paid to the rider when the box is in your hands.
  • Your pair ships the moment your Care deposit reaches us. Change your mind before dispatch and it comes back to you in full.
  • If you will not be available, reply to the WhatsApp confirmation and we will reschedule.

settings.title: Exchanges
settings.kicker: Five days to swap the size.
settings.body:
• Message us within 5 days of delivery with your order number.
  • The pair must be unworn outside, in the original box, with the Supply Unit seal still attached.
  • Send it back to us with the courier of your choice. The return courier charge is paid by you. Once it reaches us and passes the check, your new size is dispatched.
  • If the size you need is sold out, we refund the item price to your bank account or mobile wallet.
  • Sale pairs cannot be exchanged for size. Defects within 30 days are still covered.

settings.title: Defects
settings.body: If stitching opens or a sole separates in normal wear within 30 days of delivery, send photos on WhatsApp. We replace the pair, or refund it if no replacement is available. Wear and tear, scuffs and misuse are not defects.

settings.title: The slice
settings.kicker: A slice of every pair is not ours to keep.
settings.body:
• At least 5% of the profit we make on every pair is set aside for people in need. It is a share of our profit, never added to your price.
  • Every quarter the slices are given together to one verified case of need, after our own checks.
  • Buyers vote in the bag for the cause. The most chosen cause receives the quarter's slice.
  • Date, amount and the case are published on Our Giving and on our social pages.

settings.title: Size guide
settings.body: Trace your foot on paper and measure from heel to the tip of your longest toe in centimetres. Match the closest length in the Size Guide. Between sizes, go for the larger one.
